newsitem.title: UK: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly higher.
newsitem.headline: Cazenove Indian GDR Index slightly higher.

text.p: The Cazenove Indian GDR Index was 0.95 points or 1.35 percent higher at 71.34 after the Bombay Stock Exchange 30 share index rose 9.21 points or 0.30 percent to 3,119.40 in early trade.
The premium for GDRs over stocks on the local market was 18.02 percent after 16.44 percent on Friday.
The Cazenove index is a capitalisation-weighted basket of Indian global depositary receipts and measures the change from midday on the previous trading day to midday today.
